events.headline: ZeroBounce PAYG starts at $39 for 2,000 credits while ZeroBounce ONE bundles 10,000 monthly credits at $99/mo.
events.detail: ZeroBounce ONE rolls unused credits forward and includes finder credits and inbox placement tests; pure PAYG 10k packs run ~$129 vs $39 at MillionVerifier.

events.headline: RB2B Starter ($79/mo) delivers US LinkedIn URLs to Slack only—business emails and CRM sync start on Pro ($149/mo).
events.detail: Free tier stays at 150 monthly company-level IDs. Pro ($149/mo) and Pro+ ($199/mo) start at 600 monthly person-level resolutions.

events.headline: Instantly prices Outreach Growth at $47/mo (5k sends) and bills Growth Credits lead data separately at +$47/mo.
events.detail: Hypergrowth runs ~$107/mo for 125,000 sends and 25,000 contacts; combined VIP Starter starts at $94/mo for 5,000 sends and 1,500 lead credits.

events.headline: Smartlead Pro stays at $94/mo ($78 annual) for 90k sends while Unlimited Smart ($174/mo) bundles 50k verified emails.
events.detail: Verified prospect email add-on costs $59/mo on Base ($39) and Pro ($94), and is included free on Unlimited Smart ($174/mo) and Prime ($379/mo).

events.headline: Apollo charges 8 credits per phone reveal and enforces a 3-seat minimum ($357/mo) on Organization.
events.detail: Basic ($49/seat annual) grants 30,000 credits/yr and Professional ($79/seat annual) grants 48,000 credits/yr. Credits expire at the end of the applicable billing cycle. Qualified plans can purchase add-on credits.

events.headline: Clay separates billing into Actions and Data Credits across Launch ($185/mo) and Growth ($495/mo).
events.detail: All tiers include unlimited workspace seats. Launch ($185/mo monthly, $167 annual) bundles 2,500 Data Credits and 15,000 Actions; Growth ($495/mo monthly, $446 annual) unlocks CRM sync, HTTP API, and webhooks with 6,000 Data Credits and 40,000 Actions.
